entities.summary: Wang Gao was a Chinese warlord near the end of the Tang dynasty. Born into a wealthy and powerful military dynasty, he served as the largely independent military governor of Yiwu, succeeding his father Wang Chucun to the post in 895 and losing it to his cousin Wang Chuzhi in 900 after fleeing battle with the forces of Zhu Quanzhong, the warlord who subsequently established the Later Liang Empire.
